reportedSymptom: Boards, Users, Settings, and Account are currently reported as no longer functional.

entries.summary: Checked-in public Supabase configuration is intentionally empty, so an unconfigured local run cannot enter authenticated protected modules.
entries.reproduction: Start Vite without VITE_SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and request #/boards, #/users, #/settings, or #/account.
failureSignatures: Cloud authentication must be configured before Work Management can be used.

entries.summary: Board routing publishes React facade state and immediately enters the imperative renderer, which synchronously resolves the React-owned Board host; React commit timing is therefore an explicit failure boundary.
entries.reproduction: Enter #/boards or #/boards/:id during a transition where the React Board host has not committed before boardsFeature.render* resolves the host.
failureSignatures: Work Management React Board presentation facade host is missing.
runtime route=boards while React Board host reports view=hidden and hidden=true
entries.certificationObservation: Operator evidence captured an authenticated Boards route with the React Board host inactive/hidden while the visible Board error state reported a wm_list_boards backend failure.

entries.summary: Boards depend on deployed wm_* RPCs and explicitly surface an outdated-backend failure when the configured-board authority is absent.
entries.reproduction: Use an authenticated session against a project missing current Board RPC migrations, then list/create/open a board.

entries.summary: The Users directory is unavailable if list_user_directory is missing, unauthorized, stale in PostgREST schema cache, or the authenticated administrator context cannot be established.
entries.reproduction: Open #/users as an administrator while returning an RPC error from list_user_directory.
failureSignatures: Your session expired. Sign in again.
authenticated users route reached but data-wm-management-view=users absent
entries.certificationObservation: First operator run observed Users management view count 0 in one execution; another execution mounted the route but did not surface the expected directory-error text before timeout.

entries.summary: User mutations still use protected RPC authority; the M28 admin-sync-auth-access Edge Function is present in source but intentionally not the browser authority until external deployment/cutover.
entries.reproduction: Inspect the Users mutation path and M28 target/cutover documentation.

entries.summary: Settings is React-owned behind the authenticated management runtime; route mount, DOM ownership, shell inert/hidden state, storage APIs, diagnostics, compatibility checks, and backup operations require integrated browser characterization.
entries.reproduction: Open #/settings under the fixture session and run Platform verification; record route/auth/DOM/network/backend evidence.
failureSignatures: authenticated settings route reached but data-wm-management-view=settings absent
Run diagnostics control repeatedly detached before activation
entries.certificationObservation: First operator run observed Settings management view count 0 in one execution and repeated diagnostics-button DOM detachment in another.

entries.summary: Account route rendering and profile/security/session mutations require a valid hydrated cloud identity and were not covered by the previous login-only Playwright smoke.
entries.reproduction: Open #/account under the fixture session and submit a profile change while capturing backend response and UI feedback.
failureSignatures: Account settings could not be updated.
authenticated account route reached but data-wm-management-view=account absent
entries.certificationObservation: First operator run observed Account management view count 0 under the authenticated fixture before the intended profile-RPC characterization completed.

entries.summary: Prior Playwright coverage proves login composition ownership only; prior management execution verification exercises in-memory show/hide state rather than authenticated user workflows.
entries.reproduction: Inspect the M30 application smoke and M13 management execution verifier.
failureSignatures: M30 generic Playwright runner discovered M37 environment-specific fixture tests during release:check
entries.certificationObservation: The first M37 certification run demonstrated test-runner coupling: the M30 generic Playwright command executed M37 fixture tests without the dedicated fixture Vite environment.

entries.summary: Legacy Account, Settings, and User Management feature implementations remain exported/listed even though React AuthenticatedManagementUI is the declared route owner.
entries.reproduction: Inspect runtime exports/runtime-assets and compare them with application-manifest route ownership.
entries.resolution: M44 removed the three obsolete imperative management controllers, retired their runtime exports/cache entries, and consolidated Account/Settings/Users lifecycle ownership under one management runtime feature.
